scripts.name: STRATUS - AWS - Delete CloudTrail Trail
scripts.description:
Stratus Red Team cloud adversary-emulation technique for AWS.

Delete CloudTrail Trail

Delete a CloudTrail trail. Simulates an attacker disrupting CloudTrail logging. Warm-up: - Create a CloudTrail trail Detonation: - Delete the CloudTrail trail

Morgana executes the official Stratus technique using an isolated MORGANA_TEST_ID correlation ID. Prerequisite infrastructure is handled by Stratus warmup. Cleanup uses the same correlation ID.
scripts.command:
# Stratus Red Team — Delete CloudTrail Trail
# Correlation ID = Morgana Test ID for Detection Fabric correlation
STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID="${MORGANA_TEST_ID:-$(uuidgen 2>/dev/null || cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid 2>/dev/null || echo manual)}"
export STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID

if [ -n "#{stratus_aws_profile}" ]; then export AWS_PROFILE="#{stratus_aws_profile}"; fi
if [ -n "#{stratus_aws_region}" ]; then export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION="#{stratus_aws_region}"; fi

# Select Stratus binary for this Agent OS
if command -v stratus >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  STRATUS_BIN=stratus
else
  STRATUS_BIN="{{asset:stratus_linux_amd64}}"
  chmod +x "$STRATUS_BIN" 2>/dev/null || true
fi

echo "[INFO] Stratus Red Team: technique=aws.defense-evasion.cloudtrail-delete"
echo "[INFO] Correlation ID: $STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID"

# Warmup + Detonate
"$STRATUS_BIN" detonate aws.defense-evasion.cloudtrail-delete
EXIT_CODE=$?

echo "[INFO] Detonation complete: exit=$EXIT_CODE technique=aws.defense-evasion.cloudtrail-delete"
# Emit structured result
echo "MORGANA_RESULT_METADATA={\"provider\":\"stratus-red-team\",\"technique_id\":\"aws.defense-evasion.cloudtrail-delete\",\"correlation_id\":\"$STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID\",\"exit_code\":$EXIT_CODE}"
exit $EXIT_CODE
scripts.cleanup_command:
# Stratus Red Team cleanup — uses SAME correlation ID as detonation
# MORGANA_TEST_ID must match the value used during detonate
STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID="${MORGANA_TEST_ID:-manual}"
export STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID

if command -v stratus >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  STRATUS_BIN=stratus
else
  STRATUS_BIN="{{asset:stratus_linux_amd64}}"
fi

"$STRATUS_BIN" cleanup aws.defense-evasion.cloudtrail-delete
CLEANUP_EXIT=$?
echo "[INFO] Cleanup complete: exit=$CLEANUP_EXIT technique=aws.defense-evasion.cloudtrail-delete"
exit $CLEANUP_EXIT

source_metadata.detection: Identify when a CloudTrail trail is deleted, through CloudTrail's DeleteTrail event. GuardDuty also provides a dedicated finding type, [Stealth:IAMUser/CloudTrailLoggingDisabled](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/guardduty_finding-types-iam.html#stealth-iam-cloudtrailloggingdisabled).

scripts.name: STRATUS - AWS - Attempt to Leave the AWS Organization
scripts.description:
Stratus Red Team cloud adversary-emulation technique for AWS.

Attempt to Leave the AWS Organization

Attempts to leave the AWS Organization (unsuccessfully - will hit an AccessDenied error). Security configurations are often defined at the organization level (GuardDuty, SecurityHub, CloudTrail...). Leaving the organization can disrupt or totally shut down these controls.
